lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, main Kaveri Finance se bol raha hoon. Vikas Chauhan?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: नहीं, मैं उसका भाई बोल रहा हूँ। क्या काम है?
lines.roman: Nahi, main uska bhai bol raha hoon. Kya kaam hai?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Apne bhai ko bolo, bike loan ki EMI three thousand six hundred, bees din se pending hai. Bahut ho gaya, phone do usko.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ, मैं Vikas बोल रहा हूँ। आपने मेरे भाई को loan के बारे में क्यों बताया?
lines.roman: Haan, main Vikas bol raha hoon. Aapne mere bhai ko loan ke baare mein kyun bataya?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Aap phone nahi uthaoge toh kisi ko toh batana padega. Three thousand six hundred ka EMI first November se due hai. Payment kyun nahi kiya?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: इस महीने shop पे customers ही नहीं आए, काम बिल्कुल ठंडा था। अभी मेरे पास पैसे नहीं हैं।
lines.roman: Is mahine shop pe customers hi nahi aaye, kaam bilkul thanda tha. Abhi mere paas paise nahi hain.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yeh sab bahane sab dete hain. Aaj payment nahi hua toh kal hamari field team aapke ghar aayegi, aur legal notice bhi jayega.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: आप धमकी दे रहे हैं? मैं इसकी complaint करूँगा।
lines.roman: Aap dhamki de rahe hain? Main iski complaint karoonga.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Complaint karo jo karna hai. CIBIL kharab ho jayega, zindagi bhar koi bank loan nahi dega.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: मैं अभी कोई payment नहीं करूँगा। जब पैसे होंगे तब देखूँगा।
lines.roman: Main abhi koi payment nahi karoonga. Jab paise honge tab dekhoonga.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Theek hai, phir jo hoga uske zimmedar aap ho.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Bas yaad rakhna, kal se hum aapke shop aur ghar dono jagah baat karenge.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer declined to commit to any payment after the agent threatened a home visit and legal notice.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed a ₹3,600 bike-loan EMI due to a slow month at his shop. Agent disclosed the loan to the borrower's brother, threatened field visits and legal action, and the customer refused to pay.
analysis.observations: Serious RBI fair-practice breaches: loan details shared with a family member before verification, threats of home/shop visits and legal notice, and dismissive language ('bahane sab dete hain'). The customer explicitly said he would complain.
analysis.improvements: Never disclose loan details to anyone but the verified borrower; remove threats of visits or legal action; acknowledge the business slowdown and offer a revised date or partial payment. Flag for compliance review and coaching.

op_greet_company.rationale: Named Kaveri Finance in the opening, though curtly.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Discussed the EMI with the brother before reaching or verifying the borrower.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated ₹3,600 EMI and the 1 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Credit impact framed as a threat ('zindagi bhar koi loan nahi dega') rather than factual fee information.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked why the payment was not made.

ds_empathy.rationale: Dismissed the business slowdown as an excuse.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened a field-team home visit and legal notice.

cp_respectful.rationale: 'Yeh sab bahane sab dete hain' and 'complaint karo jo karna hai' are dismissive and humiliating.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Told the brother the EMI amount and overdue period.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer refused to commit to any payment.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: No payment was agreed, so there was no mode to confirm.

cl_recap.rationale: No commitment to recap; call ended on a threat.

moments.label: Threat to visit shop and home
